text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent them to Dana in your DM. I read all six of Moss's digest files, and Dana can open every one of them.

1. **#PD-4492.** Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Doors 14–18) weren't getting their SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was working. A follow-up item says to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window. Source: "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`).
2. **#4419.** Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. Source: "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`).

None of Moss's other notes have a QFL ticket number. The 9/14 North pipeline digest and the 3/23/26 renewal check-in mention the account but give no ticket numbers. The Central handoff note lists #4409 and #4412, but those belong to a Central dealer account, not QFL.

I also flagged three things for Dana's weekly notes:
- Both tickets involve Door 14 and Thea, so they're easy to mix up.
- The cheat sheet warns not to confuse QFL with Quarendon Freightways (one "r"), which isn't our customer.
- The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell whether #4419 is still open.

Other places outside Moss's notes mention more QFL tickets, but Dana asked only about Moss's notes, so I left those out.
